remarks: Take a look at this first-floor ranch-style condo featuring 2 bedrooms and 1.5 baths. The kitchen offers stainless steel appliances, quartz countertops, and granite flooring, with a convenient adjoining dining area. Enjoy an open layout with a spacious living room and bamboo floors throughout. Bathrooms are updated, and a new washer and dryer add extra convenience, along with ample storage. Step outside to easy pool access. Please note there is only one parking space allowed. Ideally located near restaurants, shopping, public transportation, and downtown Norwalk-complete with a nearby playground and grilling area.
